title: Community Service Learning Project
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Grade 9 implements and reports. Keep the report short: problem, solution, what was done, results, lessons.

skills.key_step: The child orders the project steps and says what the final report contains.

floor.question: What comes after designing a solution?

steps: Write the report: problem, solution, work, results, lessons.
contexts: a school garden for a children's home
a reading day at a nursery school

board.do: Wait for what changed after the project.
Fill one heading as an example.

misconceptions.ask: What is the first step in a community service project?
misconceptions.repair: Lay the five step cards in a line and ask what each needs from the one before.
Hold up a plan (future: who, what, when) and a report (past: what was done) side by side.
Ask: can you write about results before the work? Put the report last.

listen_for: Only the names of the learners
misconceptions.ask: What should a CSL report include?
misconceptions.repair: Give a report frame with five headings.

checks.question: What is the first step in a community service project?
Give two things a CSL report should include.
checks.answer: any two of: the problem, the solution, what was done, results, lessons
